sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

The 
first draft initiated and tested by eng. Alaa Ibrahim Elshal , reviewed by eng. Ali Abdel Galil Abdel Kader تمت مراجعته بواسطة EDEPC مراقبة الجودة المهندس عبد المنعم الإمام، accepted by I & C 
dept. manager eng. Mohamad Ellawindi , and approved by eng. Mohammad Elsarag head sector of 
Demiatta CCPS

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general 
 director and MPIS Coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector
Components

The PLC system consist of:
Programmable logic controller C 100 consists of the following units:

One 
 control unit type (5120 - 8)

One 
 power supply type (5 F00 - 220 A) 24 VDC, Vmin = 20 V, Vmax = 28 V

One 
 coupler type (5800)

One 
 RS232 interface (58X1)

اثنان 
 وحدات للمدخلات التناظرية من النوع (5212)

One 
 module for logic inputs type (5211)

Two 
 module for logic outputs type (5302)

One 
 module for analog outputs 1/5v type (5315.V)

واحد 
 وحدة للمخرجات التناظرية 4/20 مللي أمبير من النوع (5315.I)

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Unit in stand still
Cleaning all cards
Tightening

Check the power supply o.k green 
 lamp LED located in the power supply module (5f00)

إذا كان المصباح الأخضر LED قيد التشغيل 
 وحدة العرض موافق
If not change the P.S. module
Using the CEGELEC console

Push the two (ON) push bottom 
 simultaneously (of CEGELEC console)
Choose the (debug) by enter F5

Choose the data sequence by the 
 cursor

اختر تسلسل الاختبار رقم 2(من 
 مانويل)
Observe the data of sequence # 2

If the numerical number 
 associated to the data equal 5000 or 2000 : the module which under test from 
 the I/O modules is failure change the defective module

إذا كانت القراءة أقل من 2000 ل 
 جميع وحدات الإدخال/الإخراج (الوحدات) على ما يرام
Close the work order
